title: CBDT Notifies Noida SEZ Authority for Income Tax Exemption Under Income-tax Act, 2025
content:
# CBDT Notifies Noida SEZ Authority for Income Tax Exemption Under Income-tax Act, 2025

Ek important update hai. Government ne Noida Special Economic Zone Authority ko Income-tax Act, 2025 ke Schedule III ke तहत income tax exemption ke liye notify kiya hai.

*   **What's New:** The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has officially notified the Noida Special Economic Zone Authority (having PAN AAALN0639A) for certain income tax exemptions.
*   **Under Which Act:** This exemption is specifically granted under Section 11 read with Schedule III, Table Serial No. 36 of the new Income-tax Act, 2025.
*   **Applicability:** The provisions of this notification will be applicable for the Tax Years 2026-27 and 2027-28.
*   **Notification Details:** This important announcement has been made through Notification No. 108/2026, bearing S.O. 4320(E), and is dated August 05, 2026.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.incometax.gov.in/)
